@graph.name: AgenQ
@graph.description: AgenQ is AI training and onboarding software for insurance agencies and brokerages. Staff ask how to do a task and AgenQ shows each step on their screen inside EZLynx or AMS360. In Execution Mode, AgenQ can complete approved tasks, with a person approving the important steps.

@graph.name: EZLynx Training and Onboarding for Agency Staff | AgenQ
@graph.description: AI training and onboarding inside EZLynx. New and experienced staff ask "How do I…?" and see the steps on their screen.

mainEntity.name: Can AgenQ help onboard new employees on EZLynx?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. New hires learn EZLynx by doing real client work from the start, with the steps shown on their screen instead of weeks of shadowing.

mainEntity.name: Can AgenQ train experienced staff too?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Experienced staff get help with tasks they rarely do, without asking a colleague.

mainEntity.name: How is AgenQ different from EZLynx University, Scribe or Loom?

acceptedAnswer.text: They teach before or away from the task. AgenQ helps during the task, on the EZLynx screen.

mainEntity.name: Is AgenQ affiliated with EZLynx or Applied Systems?

@graph.name: AgenQ for EZLynx
@graph.description: AgenQ for EZLynx is AI training and onboarding software that works inside EZLynx. Insurance agency staff ask how to do a task and see each step on their EZLynx screen.
